test_title: PYST 57: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 12 Nov, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: What sum (in ₹) will earn a simple interest of ₹240 in 4 years at 20% per year rate of interest?
solution:
**Given:**

Simple Interest (SI) = ₹240

Time (t) = 4 years

Rate of Interest (r) = 20% per year

**Formula used:**

SI = (P times r times t)/(100) 

Where, P = Principal

**Calculations:**

240 = (P times 20 times 4)/(100) 

⇒ P = (240 times 100)/(20 times 4) 

⇒ P = (24000)/(80) 

⇒ P = ₹300

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**
